The Winning Live is a dream stage. 
Everyone aims for center, striving to sing 
a song of gratitude to the fans who 
supported them.

Yet, only a handful ever see that dream 
come true. Ending one's career as just a 
backup dancer was the harsh reality of 
this world...

One day, Smart Falcon was practicing for a 
live performance. However, the other 
Umamusume were losing their motivation 
during backup dancer practice.

Smart Falcon pleaded to do her best to 
express their gratitude to the fans in any 
way they could. However, her voice failed 
to reach them.

Smart Falcon found herself troubled. 
Everyone aspires to be the center. The 
brilliance born from serious competition 
is precious, but it also creates friction.

Center and back dancer... Would it be 
better if that distinction disappeared?

An Umamusume named Light Hello appears. 
Introducing herself as a producer, she 
proposes reviving a different form of live 
show... the Grand Live!
